title: Reveiw plus a little bug
body:
There is a bug i think. When you slide in the fifth island you can see the water founten spawn. I guess it’s because it is animated and take much power but just making it spawn when the player is in the islands close to it will fix the problem. Its a quick fix just hard to remember. Also the screen wont rotate wich is annoying. Those are quick fixes hope you add them in soon🤞
either way this is the best app/game ever. It makes work into a game. Love your work keep it up☝️
